facts: Training forward uses biased variance; running variance uses unbiased estimator.
Per-channel statistics over N,H,W; track_running_stats=False uses batch stats in eval too.

sources.readScope: AvgPool2d API description, defaults, ceil-mode note and shape
facts: Implicit zero padding; count_include_pad defaults true.
Default stride equals kernel_size; ceil mode skips windows starting entirely in right padding.

sources.readScope: MaxPool2d API description, defaults, negative-infinity padding and shape
facts: Padding is implicit negative infinity, not zero.
Default stride equals kernel_size; ceil mode allows trailing partial windows with start-position restriction.
